unit.why: A letter of approbation/response from R. Hayyim Halberstam of Sanz to the author, giving blessings and a ruling on switching the prayer rite from Nusach Ashkenaz to Nusach Sefard; it contains no narrated events.
unit.boundary_note: part of a series of approbation letters; the next division begins another letter (from Sighet)
